title: FARMERS NATIONAL BANC CORP /OH/ 8-K Filing — 2026-04-16
summary: Farmers National Banc Corp., a small Ohio-based regional bank (NASDAQ: FMNB), filed a Form 8-K reporting the results of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders held on April 16, 2026. Shareholders approved a new 2026 Equity Incentive Plan reserving 1,000,000 shares for equity-based awards to directors, officers, and eligible participants. All four Class I director nominees were elected, executive compensation was ratified with 85.28% support, and Crowe LLP was reappointed as independent auditor with 98.4% approval.
key_points: Shareholders approved the 2026 Equity Incentive Plan reserving 1,000,000 shares for grants of restricted stock, stock units, and share awards
Four Class I directors elected: Gregory C. Bestic (20.34M votes for), Kevin J. Helmick (20.67M), Neil J. Kaback (20.76M), and Terry A. Moore (19.41M)
Advisory vote to approve 2025 executive compensation passed with 85.28% of votes cast in favor
Crowe LLP ratified as independent auditor for fiscal year 2026 with 29.43M votes for (98.4%)
Record date: February 25, 2026; 37,738,759 shares outstanding; 78.58% voter turnout
Plan previously adopted by Board on February 24, 2026, subject to shareholder approval
